items.title: 9.8.2 Strong acids aur weak bases ke salts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.2, printed pages 204-205.

blocks.text: Strong acids aur weak bases se bane salts, jaise ammonium chloride, ke liye strong acid ka conjugate base (Cl-) pani se react nahi karta, jabke weak base ka conjugate acid (NH3 se NH4+) pani se react kar ke H3O+ ions banata hai, solution ko tezabi karte hue. NH4Cl(s) se NH4+(aq) + Cl-(aq); NH4+ weak base NH3 ka conjugate acid hai aur pani se react karta hai, NH4+(aq) + H2O(l) se NH3 + H3O+(aq); Cl- HCl ka conjugate base hai aur pH par asar nahi karta. NH4+ ion ki wajah se solution tezabi hai.

blocks.prompt: Muadle se wazahat karein ke ammonium nitrate ka solution neela litmus surkh kyun karta hai.
blocks.explanation: NH4NO3 se NH4+ aur NO3-. Nitrate, strong acid HNO3 se, react nahi karta, magar NH4+, weak base ammonia ka conjugate acid, pani ko proton deta hai: NH4+ + H2O se NH3 + H3O+. H3O+ solution ko tezabi karta hai, to neela litmus surkh ho jata hai.

items: Strong acid + weak base salt (NH4Cl): NH4+ hydrolyse ho kar NH3 + H3O+ deta hai, Cl- nahi; solution tezabi.
